narrative: On the tables. The grey cloak still on him. The pocket tables lie shut on the bed. Yesterday's smear is hidden by the cover. The cat is not on this tread. On the tables. A hand on the cover, not lifting it. Grey light from the west window. The apples are a floor below, out of sight. On the tables. The tables where they were. The stylus is in the gutter of the shut book. He has sat down.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Waited with the cover down, then wrote the three words and stopped.

entities.name: the writing-tables
entities.context: Shown on tables in Went up and sat with the tables shut
